_note: Hand-curated from the journal stories. n = stop. kind: foot | water | wheels | high. thrill 1-5 is a judgement from the story. img: photo id 'NN-KK' or video poster 'vNN-KK'.

items.name: Jungle trek down to Nunggalan Beach
items.quote: As all treks with Sidd and me go, I was crying.

items.name: Surf lessons
items.quote: By far one of the best experiences I've had as far as water activities are concerned.

items.name: Cave and river walk to Tukad Cepung
items.quote: A short trek, then you enter a cave, wade through a river and reach the falls.

items.name: Swim at Tibumana waterfall
items.quote: No one but us, and you could go into the water and take a swim!

items.name: White-water rafting
items.quote: A 2 hour ride with a nice swim in the river towards the end.

items.name: ATV ride
items.quote: I thought it was going to be as easy as driving a scooty but I was about to be proven wrong :)

items.name: Kawah Ijen night trek and the blue fire
items.quote: The trek was 3.5 km but man it felt like 30 km.

items.name: Mount Bromo: jeep convoy, sunrise and crater hike
items.quote: Lines of colourful land cruisers riding in a long convoy through the ash fields.

items.name: Scooter to Sungai Mudal, home in the rain
items.quote: We decided to just ride back in the rain.

items.name: Theme-park rides
items.quote: Like school kids, running around from ride to ride.

items.name: Road-bike ride to Batu Ferringhi
items.quote: A beautiful ride along the coast, with quite a few changes in elevation adding to the heart pump.

items.name: Scooter loop up Gunung Raya
items.quote: Much better than paying RM 85 for a cable car ride.

items.name: Jet-ski island tour
items.quote: Not for the fainthearted. I hung on for dear life while Sidd had the time of his life.

items.name: Mangrove kayaking
items.quote: The water was reducing by the minute, so we got stuck at multiple places.

items.name: Snorkelling around Nang Yuan
items.quote: Except for when I got to see a huuuge 150 yr old turtle.

items.name: Rock-and-rope scramble to John-Suwan Viewpoint
items.quote: The hike will basically turn you into Spiderman.

items.name: 32 km temple circuit by cycle (Sidd)
items.quote: Sidd left at 5 for a 32 km cycle trip across all the temples.

items.name: Off-road scooter and jetty jumps
items.quote: Exploring here meant quite a bit of treacherous off-roading.

items.name: Alpine coaster at Datanla
items.quote: Checked out the Alpine roller coaster at the Datanla waterfall.

items.name: Canyoning: zipline, swim, hike, abseil
items.quote: Every cliff I contemplated sitting out, but I'm glad I didn't.

items.name: Speedboat to Cham Island and snorkelling
items.quote: The driver drove like a maniac, the speedboat kept bumping like a jetski.

items.name: Cycling the Ninh Binh countryside
items.quote: Rented bicycles and went riding around the countryside behind the temple.

items.name: Kayaking in Bai Tu Long Bay
items.quote: My parents had turned around midway, back to the boat.

items.name: Ha Giang Loop: 3 days on scooters
items.quote: Literally a pain in the ass, but not figuratively :p

items.name: Bamboo raft to a cave, then a cold swim
items.quote: The water was extremely cold but a lot of fun!

items.name: Zip line and jumps
items.quote: Sidd kept jumping from this one platform and forced me to jump too.

items.name: Kayaking the Nam Song
items.quote: We passed all these bars while kayaking and watched everyone partying hard.

items.name: The big jump at the lagoon
items.quote: Sidd's first jump required 4 attempts, and there's a video of mine requiring "750 attempts" 😂

items.name: Swimming at Kuang Si falls
items.quote: The best were the turquoise blue pools that were created for us to swim in!

items.name: Up Mount Phousi
items.quote: Believed to be the hill Hanuman carried with the Sanjeevani.

items.name: Scooter over the "treacherous road" to Pai
items.quote: All Sidd could talk about was the "treacherous road". The weather was fantastic.

items.name: Climbing the Sticky Waterfall
items.quote: You climb up the waterfall like you're climbing stairs: 0 slipperiness, max grip.

items.name: Jungle trek in the national park
items.quote: Walking the entire trek alongside an 85 year old uncle from Germany!

items.name: Pai to Chiang Mai by scooter (Sidd)
items.quote: Sidd drove a scooty back and I came in the minivan. From what I hear, his ride was epic.
